name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands the agent to pick up the box again on the very next move when the box falls, but the clauses do not force it; the agent can ignore a box fall and reach the exit without picking it up again, which is not what the task requires. Add a hard Precedence(box_fell, pickup) to the existing ChainResponse(holding_box, box_fell) to force the agent to pick up the box on the next move when it falls.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task does not mention picking up the box on the next move when it falls; the hard Precedence(box_fell, holding_box) is not needed and can be removed; keep the hard ChainResponse(holding_box, box_fell).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to reach the exit with the box in its hands, but the hard ChainResponse(holding_box, box_fell) is not enough to ensure this. Adding a soft Existence(at_exit) and hard Precedence(at_exit, holding_box) would ensure that the agent reaches the exit with the box, and then picks it up. This would be the correct interpretation of the task, but the machine would only reward the episode if the agent reaches the exit with the box.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses correctly capture the task requirements, including carrying the box to the exit and picking it up again when it falls. The compiled machine reflects these requirements and will reward the agent for reaching the exit with the box, and for picking up the box when it falls.
